verdict.rationale: AWS documents first-party headless automation. The AWS CLI controls services from the command line and automates them through scripts, CloudFormation and CDK provision infrastructure as code, and IAM OIDC federation connects CI systems such as GitHub Actions to AWS using temporary role credentials. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline setup docs (e.g. non-interactive auth and output configuration for runners), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: you can control multiple AWS services from the command line and automate them through scripts
OIDC connects applications, like GitHub Actions, that do not run on AWS to AWS resources.
when you assume a role, it provides you with temporary security credentials for your role session
CloudFormation takes care of provisioning and configuring those resources for you
you deploy your CDK applications through AWS CloudFormation to provision or update your resources
